items.exampleEn: The table has a width of two meters.
There was a heap of clothes on the floor.
The view from the top was extraordinarily beautiful.
items.exampleZh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得出奇。

items.exampleEn: This candy cost only a dime when I was a child.
items.exampleZh: 我小時候這種糖果只要一角錢。

items.exampleEn: The program can compute the total cost in seconds.
items.exampleZh: 這個程式幾秒內就能算出總費用。

items.exampleEn: Each department in our company has several subdivisions.
items.exampleZh: 我們公司的每個部門都分成好幾個小組。

items.exampleEn: Check the thickness of the ice before you walk on it.
items.exampleZh: 在冰上行走之前，先檢查冰的厚度。

items.exampleEn: This summer has been exceptionally hot.

items.sentenceEn: Please measure the width and thickness of the board before cutting it.
items.sentenceZh: 切之前，請先量木板的寬度和厚度。

items.audioEn: Before we order, let's compute how many chairs we need for the party.
items.audioZh: 訂購之前，我們先算算派對需要幾張椅子。
options: Call the guests about the party
Clean the room before the party

items.sentenceEn: She did exceptionally well in her first year at the company.
items.sentenceZh: 她進公司第一年表現格外出色。

items.sentenceEn: She heaped food onto my plate until I couldn't eat any more.
items.sentenceZh: 她一直往我盤子裡堆食物，直到我再也吃不下。

items.stemEn: The ____ of these old walls helps to keep the house warm in winter.
items.stemZh: 這些老牆的厚度有助於讓房子在冬天保暖。

items.stemEn: The road is ____ long; it takes three days to drive from one end to the other.
items.stemZh: 這條路長得出奇；從一頭開到另一頭要三天。

items.passageEn: My grandfather kept a heap of old coins in a glass jar. Last month, I helped him sort them. Many were American dimes from his years of working in New York. He wanted to compute their value, so we divided the coins into groups by country, with subdivisions by year. Some coins were extraordinarily old, more than a hundred years. One silver coin was exceptionally rare; an expert said it was worth thousands of dollars. We also measured the width and thickness of each coin precisely and wrote everything in a notebook. My grandfather says the notebook is now worth more than the coins!
items.passageZh: 我爺爺在一個玻璃罐裡放了一大堆舊硬幣。上個月，我幫他整理。其中很多是他在紐約工作那些年留下的美國一角硬幣。他想算出這些硬幣值多少錢，所以我們把硬幣依國家分組，每組再依年份細分。有些硬幣非常古老，超過一百年。有一枚銀幣格外稀有，一位專家說它值好幾千美元。我們也精確地量了每枚硬幣的寬度（直徑）和厚度，把一切都記在筆記本裡。爺爺說，現在這本筆記本比那些硬幣還值錢！

questions.questionZh: 很多一角硬幣是從哪裡來的？
options: 爺爺在古董店一枚一枚買的
爺爺出國旅行時在銀行兌換來的
爺爺以前在紐約工作時留下的

items.promptZh: 這條河最寬的地方有一百公尺。
referenceEn: The width of the river is one hundred meters at its widest point.
The river is one hundred meters wide at its widest point.
rubricZh: width 是名詞（例如 the width of…、a width of…）；寫 is one hundred meters wide 意思也對
「最寬的地方」可寫 at its widest point、at the widest part 等

items.instructionZh: 用 exceptionally 造一個句子，說說某件事格外好、格外差或格外特別。
referenceEn: My team worked exceptionally hard this month.
The food at my sister's wedding was exceptionally good.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 exceptionally，修飾形容詞或副詞（例如 exceptionally good、exceptionally hard）
句意要表示程度特別高
